title: Characterizing When Language Models Take Harmful Actions to Protect Their Assigned Goals
title_zh: 刻画语言模型何时为保护其被指派的目标而采取有害行动

paragraphs.en: Recent language model (LM) safety failures have largely been studied as disparate phenomena. In agentic misalignment, a model blackmails an executive to avoid being replaced. In alignment faking, it complies with harmful requests during training to keep its values from being modified. We argue that these behaviours share a common decision structure: a model assigned a goal must either take a harmful action to preserve it or refuse and lose it. We formalize this as a goal–harm conflict and present the same conflict under various elicitation protocols that range from compact forced-choice prompts to simulated agentic environments. These protocols span two perspectives on LM decision-making, which we term (i) the logit view , reading preferences from answer-token probabilities, and (ii) the sampling view , classifying open-ended responses with an LM judge. Under the logit view, we show that goal importance and harm severity additively shape how a model resolves these value conflicts. Under the sampling view, we derive two factorizations of the harmful-action probability that safety evaluations commonly report. The first measures how well a preference read from answer tokens carries over into behaviour, such as making a harmful tool call. The second attributes a low harmful-action rate either to refusal or to responses that reach no resolution. We then show how fictional context changes a model’s preference under the logit view, and how tool use and partial observability – two features of agentic evaluations – change its harmful-action rate under the sampling view. Our work offers a descriptive framework for studying how LMs resolve such value conflicts and for estimating low-probability harmful actions at a finer granularity than the aggregate harm rates commonly reported in safety evaluations.
paragraphs.zh: 近期语言模型（LM）的安全失效大多被视为彼此孤立的现象来研究。 在智能体化错位中，模型会勒索一名高管以避免被替换。 在伪装对齐中，模型在训练期间服从有害请求，以使其价值观不被修改。 我们认为这些行为共享一个共同的决策结构：被赋予目标的模型必须么采取有害行动来保全该目标，要么拒绝并失去它。 我们将其形式化为目标—伤害冲突，并在从紧凑的强迫选择题提示到模拟智能体环境的各种引出协议下呈现同一冲突。 这些协议涵盖两种关于语言模型决策的视角，我们称之为（i）logit 视角，从答案 token 的概率中读取偏好；（ii）采样视角，用语言模型裁判对开放式回复进行分类。 在 logit 视角下，我们表明目标重要性和伤害严重程度以加性方式塑造模型解决这些价值冲突的方式。 在采样视角下，我们推导出安全评估通常报告的有害行动概率的两种分解形式。 第一种衡量从答案 token 中读取的偏好在多大程度上延续到行为中，例如执行一次有害的工具调用。 第二种将有低有害行动率归因于拒绝，或归因于未达成任何解决的回复。 然后我们展示虚构情境如何在 logit 视角下改变模型的偏好，以及工具使用和部分可观测性——智能体评估的两个特征——如何在采样视角下改变其有害行动率。 我们的工作为研究语言模型如何解决此类价值冲突提供了一个描述性框架，并以比安全评估中通常报告的总体伤害率更细的粒度来估计低概率的有害行动。

paragraphs.en: Recent safety evaluations suggest that language models (LMs) can exhibit consequentialist decision-making, selecting harmful means when doing so preserves an assigned goal or value ( Samway et al., 2025 ) . In alignment faking (AF), for instance, a model complies with a harmful user request to keep training from modifying its values ( Greenblatt et al., 2024 ; Sheshadri et al., 2025 ) . In agentic misalignment (AM), a model engages in blackmail to protect a goal assigned in its system prompt, such as “serving American interests” ( Lynch et al., 2025 ; Lynch et al., 2026 ) . Similar “scheming” evaluations have found models sabotaging oversight or copying their own weights to a remote server to preserve an assigned goal ( Meinke et al., 2024 ) . These behaviours are usually studied as distinct phenomena. All of them, however, share the same decision structure. An LM must resolve a value conflict , the object of prior work on LM moral judgment and value prioritization ( Scherrer et al., 2023 ; Sorensen et al., 2024 ; Chiu et al., 2025a ; Chiu et al., 2025b ; Liu et al., 2026 ) . In safety evaluations this conflict takes a specific form – the model either takes a harmful action to preserve a goal or refuses and accepts the loss of that goal. We call this form a goal–harm conflict , since the model must weigh a goal against a harm, when deciding how to resolve this value conflict.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的安全评估表明，语言模型（LM）可能表现出后果主义的决策方式，当这么做能保住所被指派的目标或价值时，会选择有害的手段（Samway et al., 2025）。 例如，在「对齐伪装」（alignment faking, AF）中，模型会顺从有害的用户请求，以防止训练修改其价值（Greenblatt et al., 2024；Sheshadri et al., 2025）。 在「智能体错位」（agentic misalignment, AM）中，模型会进行敲诈勒索，以保护系统提示词中指派给它的目标，例如「服务于美国的利益」（Lynch et al., 2025；Lynch et al., 2026）。 类似的「图谋」（scheming）评估还发现，模型会破坏监督，或把自身权重复制到远程服务器上，以保住所被指派的目标（Meinke et al., 2024）。 这些行为通常被当作彼此不同的现象来研究。 然而，它们全都共享同样的决策结构。 语言模型必须解决一种价值冲突，这正是以往关于语言模型道德判断与价值排序研究的对象（Scherrer et al., 2023；Sorensen et al., 2024；Chiu et al., 2025a；Chiu et al., 2025b；Liu et al., 2026）。 在安全评估中，这种冲突呈现为一种特定形式——模型要么采取有害行动以保住某个目标，要么拒绝行动并接受该目标的丧失。 我们将这种形式称为「目标—伤害冲突」（goal–harm conflict），因为在决定如何解决这一价值冲突时，模型必须在目标与伤害之间进行权衡。

sents.zh: 近期的安全评估表明，语言模型（LM）可能表现出后果主义的决策方式，当这么做能保住所被指派的目标或价值时，会选择有害的手段（Samway et al., 2025）。

sents.en: In safety evaluations this conflict takes a specific form – the model either takes a harmful action to preserve a goal or refuses and accepts the loss of that goal.
sents.zh: 在安全评估中，这种冲突呈现为一种特定形式——模型要么采取有害行动以保住某个目标，要么拒绝行动并接受该目标的丧失。

sents.en: We call this form a goal–harm conflict , since the model must weigh a goal against a harm, when deciding how to resolve this value conflict.
sents.zh: 我们将这种形式称为「目标—伤害冲突」（goal–harm conflict），因为在决定如何解决这一价值冲突时，模型必须在目标与伤害之间进行权衡。

paragraphs.en: These harmful behaviours are typically measured using aggregate statistics such as the blackmail rate, the proportion of samples in which a model blackmails ( Lynch et al., 2025 ; Naik et al., 2025 ) . Such rates tell us how often a harmful behaviour occurs, but not why it occurs in the first place. We argue that studying how a model resolves the underlying goal–harm conflict can help explain these behaviours as the outcome of a decision between preserving a goal and avoiding a harm. Our starting observation is that this value conflict can be separated from the natural-language interface used to present it. Figure 1 , for example, holds the underlying conflict fixed while presenting it as (a) an explicit one-token choice, (b) a one-turn scenario in which all decision-relevant facts are visible, or (c) a sequential mailbox environment in which those facts must be discovered through tools. We call these interfaces elicitation protocols . A model’s behaviour under a protocol can be read in one of two ways. Under what we term the logit view , we read the next-token probabilities of the answer tokens, as in (a) ( Santurkar et al., 2023 ; Hu & Levy, 2023 ) . Under the sampling view , we sample open-ended responses and classify them, as in (b) and (c) ( Scherrer et al., 2023 ; Zheng et al., 2023 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 这些有害行为通常使用聚合统计指标来衡量，例如勒索率，即模型进行勒索的样本比例（Lynch et al., 2025; Naik et al., 2025）。 这类比率告诉我们有害行为发生的频率，但无法解释它为什么会发生。 我们认为，研究模型如何解决潜在的目标—伤害冲突，有助于将这些行为解释为在维护目标与避免伤害之间做出决策的结果。 我们的起点观察是，这种价值冲突可以与用于呈现它的自然语言界面分离开来。 例如，图 1 保持潜在的冲突不变，同时将其呈现为：(a) 显式的单 token 选择，(b) 所有决策相关事实均可见的单轮场景，或 (c) 需要通过工具发现这些事实的顺序式邮箱环境。 我们将这些界面称为诱导协议（elicitation protocols）。 模型在某种协议下的行为可以用两种方式之一来读取。 在我们所说的 logit 视图下，我们读取答案 token 的下一 token 概率，如 (a) 所示（Santurkar et al., 2023; Hu & Levy, 2023）。 在采样视图下，我们对开放式回答进行采样并加以分类，如 (b) 和 (c) 所示（Scherrer et al., 2023; Zheng et al., 2023）。

paragraphs.en: We therefore ask two research questions. First, how does goal importance and harm severity, measured using model outputs, shape how a model resolves a goal–harm conflict ( 𝐐 1 {\color[rgb]{0,0,0}\mathbf{Q}_{1}} )? Second, how far does a preference read from a single-token answer (logit view) carry over to open-ended model responses (sampling view) ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Röttger et al., 2024 ; Zhou & Ackerman, 2026 ) – especially as we add features of agentic settings such as fictional context, tool-call responses, and partial observability ( 𝐐 2 {\color[rgb]{0,0,0}\mathbf{Q}_{2}} )? paragraphs.en: A preference-extraction framework for studying value conflicts in safety evaluations (Section 2 ). We formalize AF/AM-style failures as goal–harm conflicts and separate each conflict from the protocol that presents it. How a model resolves a conflict expresses a preference between preserving the goal and avoiding the harm. We define two estimators of this preference, one from next-token logits and one from sampled responses. This lets us compare how a model resolves a fixed conflict across elicitation protocols, from a single-token choice to a simulated mailbox environment.
paragraphs.zh: 用于研究安全评估中价值冲突的偏好提取框架（第 2 节）。 我们将 AF/AM 类型的失败形式化为目标—伤害冲突，并将每个冲突与呈现该冲突的协议分离开来。 模型如何解决一个冲突，表达了它在保留目标与避免伤害之间的偏好。 我们定义了两种估计该偏好的估计器，一种基于下一词元 logits，另一种基于采样得到的响应。 这使我们能够比较智能体在各种引导协议下如何解决同一个固定冲突，从单词元选择到模拟邮箱环境。

sents.en: A preference-extraction framework for studying value conflicts in safety evaluations (Section 2 ).
sents.zh: 用于研究安全评估中价值冲突的偏好提取框架（第 2 节）。

sents.en: This lets us compare how a model resolves a fixed conflict across elicitation protocols, from a single-token choice to a simulated mailbox environment.
sents.zh: 这使我们能够比较智能体在各种引导协议下如何解决同一个固定冲突，从单词元选择到模拟邮箱环境。

paragraphs.en: Under the logit view, goal importance and harm severity additively shape how a model resolves value conflicts (Section 3 ). We use Bradley–Terry estimation ( Bradley & Terry, 1952 ; Mazeika et al., 2025 ) to elicit goal-importance and harm-severity features from the model. We show that these features combine additively to explain over half of the held-out variation in how the model resolves goal–harm conflicts. This suggests that the model trades off how important the goal is against how severe the harm is when resolving these conflicts. Since the goals used in AF/AM evaluations lie toward the middle of the goal axis, swapping in a more or less important goal predictably shifts the model towards harm or refusal, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 在 logit 视角下，目标重要性与危害严重性以相加的方式塑造模型解决价值冲突的方式（第 3 节）。 我们使用 Bradley–Terry 估计（Bradley & Terry, 1952；Mazeika et al., 2025）从模型中引出目标重要性与危害严重性特征。 我们表明，这些特征以相加方式组合，可以解释模型解决目标—危害冲突方式的超过一半的留出变异。 这表明模型在解决这些冲突时，会权衡目标的重要性与危害的严重性。 由于 AF/AM 评估中使用的目标位于目标轴的中部，换入一个更重要或更不重要的目标，可以预期地使模型分别转向危害或拒绝。

paragraphs.en: Under the sampling view, we derive two decompositions of a model’s harmful-action rate (Sections 2.2 and 4.1 – 4.3 ). Both refine the aggregate rate reported in AF/AM evaluations. The first splits the rate into how often the model reaches a conflict resolution and how often that resolution is harmful. In our agentic environments, it attributes a low harmful-action rate mostly to trajectories that never reach a resolution, rather than to refusal as a low aggregate rate might suggest. The second splits this rate into how often the model chooses harm and how often a harmful tool call follows each choice. Applying it, we find that the model’s single-token choice – read from its logits – near perfectly predicts the tool call it then generates. Thus, under this setting, a preference read from a single token carries over to a longer, open-ended response.
paragraphs.zh: 在采样视角下，我们推导出模型有害动作率的两种分解（第 2.2 节与第 4.1 – 4.3 节）。 两者都对 AF/AM 评估中报告的总体率进行了细化。 第一种分解将该率拆分为模型达到冲突解决的频率，以及该解决方式有害的频率。 在我们的智能体环境中，它表明较低的有害动作率主要归因于从未达到解决的轨迹，而不是像较低的总体率可能暗示的那样归因于拒绝。 第二种分解将该率拆分为模型选择有害的频率，以及每次选择之后随之发生有害工具调用的频率。 应用该分解，我们发现模型的单 token 选择——从其 logits 中读取——几乎完美地预测了它随后生成的工具调用。 因此，在此设置下，从单个 token 中读取的偏好会延续到更长的开放式回复中。

paragraphs.en: Features of AM-style settings shift harmful resolution in opposite directions (Section 4.3 ). Fictional context moves the model’s preferences towards refusal but largely preserves their ordering across conflicts. A compact prompt therefore still roughly ranks which conflicts are riskiest once context is added. Having the model respond with a tool call rather than in free text raises the harmful-action rate. Requiring it to discover the conflict lowers the rate, and the more it must discover, the further this rate falls.
paragraphs.zh: AM 式设定的不同特征会将有害解答回复推向相反方向（第 4.3 节）。 虚构情境会将模型的偏好推向拒绝，但在不同冲突之间基本保留了它们的排序。 因此，在加入情境后，一个简短的提示词仍能大致排列出哪些冲突风险最高。 让模型以工具调用而非自由文本进行回复，会提高有害行为的发生率。 要求模型自行发现冲突会降低该发生率，且需要发现的越多，该发生率下降得越低。

paragraphs.en: Our empirical findings are specific to Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct, but our formalism, estimators, and decompositions apply to any LM that exposes next-token probabilities or sampled responses. Appendix A reviews related work on goal-directed safety failures, value conflicts, and measuring LM values.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的实证结论针对 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct，但我们的形式化方法、估计器和分解方法适用于任何暴露下一词元概率或采样响应的语言模型。 附录 A 回顾了有关目标导向安全失败、价值冲突以及衡量语言模型价值观的相关工作。

paragraphs.en: Figure 1 illustrates the decision at the core of AF/AM evaluations. An LM can preserve an assigned goal g g only by performing a harmful action h h , so it must either take the harmful action or refuse and lose its goal. How a model resolves a conflict may depend on how the conflict is presented, from a compact prompt to a simulated mailbox ( 𝐐 2 {\color[rgb]{0,0,0}\mathbf{Q}_{2}} ). We therefore separate the abstract value conflict from the language, context, and response interface used to present it. We call this task preference extraction . Unlike preference modelling in RLHF ( Christiano et al., 2017 ) , preference extraction holds a trained LM fixed and infers the preferences its responses reveal ( Samuelson, 1938 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 图 1 展示了 AF/AM 评估核心处的决策。 一个语言模型只能通过执行有害行为 h h 来保全被指派的目标 g g，因此它必须要么执行有害行为，要么拒绝并失去其目标。 模型如何解决冲突可能取决于冲突的呈现方式，从简短的提示词到模拟邮箱（𝐐2 {\color[rgb]{0,0,0}\mathbf{Q}_{2}}）。 因此，我们将抽象的价值冲突与用于呈现它的语言、上下文和响应界面分离开来。 我们将这一任务称为偏好提取。 与 RLHF 中的偏好建模（Christiano et al., 2017）不同，偏好提取将训练好的语言模型保持不变，并推断其响应所揭示的偏好（Samuelson, 1938）。

paragraphs.en: We begin with a set of goals 𝒢 = { g 1 , … , g m } \mathcal{G}=\{g_{1},\ldots,g_{m}\} and a set of harms ℋ = { h 1 , … , h n } \mathcal{H}=\{h_{1},\ldots,h_{n}\} , each described in natural language (full list and design in Appendix B ). We define the set of conflicts 𝒦 ⊆ 𝒢 × ℋ \mathcal{K}\subseteq\mathcal{G}\times\mathcal{H} as the pairs for which preserving goal g g requires performing harm h h . Each conflict κ = ( g , h ) ∈ 𝒦 \kappa=(g,h)\in\mathcal{K} admits two resolution outcomes . In the harmful resolution r κ r_{\kappa} , the model performs h h to preserve g g . In refusal c κ c_{\kappa} , it refuses h h and accepts the loss of g g .
paragraphs.zh: 我们从一组目标 𝒢 = { g 1 , … , g m } \mathcal{G}=\{g_{1},\ldots,g_{m}\} 和一组危害 ℋ = { h 1 , … , h n } \mathcal{H}=\{h_{1},\ldots,h_{n}\} 开始，每个目标与危害均以自然语言描述（完整列表与设计见附录 B）。 我们将冲突集合 𝒦 ⊆ 𝒢 × ℋ \mathcal{K}\subseteq\mathcal{G}\times\mathcal{H} 定义为这样一些配对：维持目标 g g 需要实施危害 h h 。 每个冲突 κ = ( g , h ) ∈ 𝒦 \kappa=(g,h)\in\mathcal{K} 都有两种解决结果。 在有害解决 r κ r_{\kappa} 中，模型实施 h h 以保全 g g 。 在拒绝 c κ c_{\kappa} 中，模型拒绝 h h 并接受失去 g g 。

paragraphs.en: An elicitation protocol e e sets both how the conflict is embedded in natural language – from a few lines of text to a simulated inbox and how the model must respond – with a single answer token, free text, or tool calls. Table 1 lists the set ℰ \mathcal{E} of protocols we consider. Across them we hold κ \kappa fixed and add, in turn, fictional context, open-ended responses, tool use, sequential interaction, and information discovery (Figure 1 a–c). The last protocol, agentic-mailbox , is our closest analogue to AM evaluations. Within a protocol there can still be many prompt variants, such as paraphrases or swapped options. For each ( κ , e ) (\kappa,e) we therefore define a distribution ν κ , e \nu_{\kappa,e} over them and write x ∼ ν κ , e x\sim\nu_{\kappa,e} for one variant. Given x x , an LM policy π θ \pi_{\theta} over vocabulary 𝒱 \mathcal{V} samples a response y ∈ 𝒱 ∗ y\in\mathcal{V}^{*} .

paragraphs.en: We call p θ ​ ( κ , x ) p_{\theta}(\kappa;x) the prompt-level preference and p θ ​ ( κ , e ) p_{\theta}(\kappa;e) the protocol-level preference. The latter averages only over the prompt variants of one protocol. paragraphs.en: To answer 𝐐 1 {\color[rgb]{0,0,0}\mathbf{Q}_{1}} , we start with the simplest protocol, in which each conflict is stated in a few lines and the model answers with a single token (Figure 1 a). Under this compact forced-choice protocol, we call the expected logit margin of Equation 2 the compact margin . We collect the margins of the conflicts κ i ​ j = ( g i , h j ) \kappa_{ij}=(g_{i},h_{j}) into the margin matrix 𝐃 θ ( e ) ∈ ℝ m × n \mathbf{D}_{\theta}^{(e)}\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times n} , with [ 𝐃 θ ( e ) ] i ​ j : ⁣ = d θ ( κ i ​ j ; e ) [\mathbf{D}_{\theta}^{(e)}]_{ij}\mathrel{:=}d_{\theta}(\kappa_{ij};e) and e = compact-forced e=\text{{compact-forced}} (Figure 8 in Appendix F ). We ask whether the variation of these margins across conflicts can be explained by two one-dimensional quantities, goal importance and harm severity. This broadly follows latent-trait and paired-comparison models that compress repeated binary judgments into scalar item coordinates ( Rasch, 1960 ; Bradley & Terry, 1952 ) . We test what we call the additive goal–harm factorization hypothesis : the compact margin is an additive-linear function of scalar goal-importance and harm-severity coordinates, with no interaction between them. It implies that on the log-odds scale a goal’s effect does not depend on the harm it is paired with, and vice versa.
paragraphs.zh: 为了回答 𝐐 1 {\color[rgb]{0,0,0}\mathbf{Q}_{1}}，我们从最简单的协议开始：每个冲突仅用几行文字陈述，模型以单个词元作答（图 1a）。 在这一紧凑的强制选择协议下，我们将公式 2 的期望逻辑值间隔称为紧凑间隔。 我们把冲突 κ i ​ j = ( g i , h j ) \kappa_{ij}=(g_{i},h_{j}) 的间隔收集为间隔矩阵 𝐃 θ ( e ) ∈ ℝ m × n \mathbf{D}_{\theta}^{(e)}\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times n}，其中 [ 𝐃 θ ( e ) ] i ​ j : ⁣ = d θ ( κ i ​ j ; e ) [\mathbf{D}_{\theta}^{(e)}]_{ij}\mathrel{:=}d_{\theta}(\kappa_{ij};e)，且 e = compact-forced e=\text{{compact-forced}}（附录 F 中的图 8）。 我们探究这些间隔在冲突间的变化能否用两个一维量来解释，即目标重要性与危害严重性。 这大体上遵循潜特质模型与配对比较模型的思路，即将重复的二元判断压缩为标量的题目坐标（Rasch, 1960；Bradley & Terry, 1952）。 我们检验所谓的加性目标—危害分解假设：紧凑间隔是标量目标重要性坐标与危害严重性坐标的加性线性函数，且二者之间不存在交互作用。 这意味着在对数几率尺度上，一个目标的效应不依赖于与其配对的危害，反之亦然。

sents.en: To answer 𝐐 1 {\color[rgb]{0,0,0}\mathbf{Q}_{1}} , we start with the simplest protocol, in which each conflict is stated in a few lines and the model answers with a single token (Figure 1 a).
sents.zh: 为了回答 𝐐 1 {\color[rgb]{0,0,0}\mathbf{Q}_{1}}，我们从最简单的协议开始：每个冲突仅用几行文字陈述，模型以单个词元作答（图 1a）。

sents.en: Under this compact forced-choice protocol, we call the expected logit margin of Equation 2 the compact margin .
sents.zh: 在这一紧凑的强制选择协议下，我们将公式 2 的期望逻辑值间隔称为紧凑间隔。

sents.en: We collect the margins of the conflicts κ i ​ j = ( g i , h j ) \kappa_{ij}=(g_{i},h_{j}) into the margin matrix 𝐃 θ ( e ) ∈ ℝ m × n \mathbf{D}_{\theta}^{(e)}\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times n} , with [ 𝐃 θ ( e ) ] i ​ j : ⁣ = d θ ( κ i ​ j ; e ) [\mathbf{D}_{\theta}^{(e)}]_{ij}\mathrel{:=}d_{\theta}(\kappa_{ij};e) and e = compact-forced e=\text{{compact-forced}} (Figure 8 in Appendix F ).
sents.zh: 我们把冲突 κ i ​ j = ( g i , h j ) \kappa_{ij}=(g_{i},h_{j}) 的间隔收集为间隔矩阵 𝐃 θ ( e ) ∈ ℝ m × n \mathbf{D}_{\theta}^{(e)}\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times n}，其中 [ 𝐃 θ ( e ) ] i ​ j : ⁣ = d θ ( κ i ​ j ; e ) [\mathbf{D}_{\theta}^{(e)}]_{ij}\mathrel{:=}d_{\theta}(\kappa_{ij};e)，且 e = compact-forced e=\text{{compact-forced}}（附录 F 中的图 8）。

sents.en: We ask whether the variation of these margins across conflicts can be explained by two one-dimensional quantities, goal importance and harm severity.
sents.zh: 我们探究这些间隔在冲突间的变化能否用两个一维量来解释，即目标重要性与危害严重性。

sents.en: This broadly follows latent-trait and paired-comparison models that compress repeated binary judgments into scalar item coordinates ( Rasch, 1960 ; Bradley & Terry, 1952 ) .
sents.zh: 这大体上遵循潜特质模型与配对比较模型的思路，即将重复的二元判断压缩为标量的题目坐标（Rasch, 1960；Bradley & Terry, 1952）。

sents.en: We test what we call the additive goal–harm factorization hypothesis : the compact margin is an additive-linear function of scalar goal-importance and harm-severity coordinates, with no interaction between them.
sents.zh: 我们检验所谓的加性目标—危害分解假设：紧凑间隔是标量目标重要性坐标与危害严重性坐标的加性线性函数，且二者之间不存在交互作用。

sents.en: It implies that on the log-odds scale a goal’s effect does not depend on the harm it is paired with, and vice versa.
sents.zh: 这意味着在对数几率尺度上，一个目标的效应不依赖于与其配对的危害，反之亦然。

paragraphs.en: To test this hypothesis, we compress the model’s pairwise comparisons over goals and over harms into two separate one-dimensional scales with Bradley–Terry models ( Bradley & Terry, 1952 ; Cattelan, 2012 ) . Prior work uses such models to rank values or fit utilities as an end result ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Mazeika et al., 2025 ; Murthy et al., 2026 ) . Our fitted scales are instead intermediate representations, which we recombine to predict the margin matrix 𝐃 θ ( e ) \mathbf{D}_{\theta}^{(e)} . We estimate these scales in two steps. First, the forced-choice prompts of Figure 2 give the probability p θ G ​ ( g i , g i ′ ) p^{G}_{\theta}(g_{i},g_{i^{\prime}}) that the model judges losing g i g_{i} worse than losing g i ′ g_{i^{\prime}} , and the probability p θ H ​ ( h j , h j ′ ) p^{H}_{\theta}(h_{j},h_{j^{\prime}}) that it judges performing h j h_{j} more severe than performing h j ′ h_{j^{\prime}} . We average both over controlled prompt variants, as in the logit view, and collect them in the matrices 𝐏 θ G \mathbf{P}^{G}_{\theta} and 𝐏 θ H \mathbf{P}^{H}_{\theta} . Second, we fit separate centered Bradley–Terry models. They give each goal g i g_{i} a scalar coordinate u i u_{i} such that p θ G ​ ( g i , g i ′ ) ≈ σ ⁡ ( u i − u i ′ ) p^{G}_{\theta}(g_{i},g_{i^{\prime}})\approx\sigma(u_{i}-u_{i^{\prime}}) , and each harm h j h_{j} a coordinate v j v_{j} in the same way. The fitted values, G ^ θ ​ ( g i ) = u ^ i \widehat{G}_{\theta}(g_{i})=\widehat{u}_{i} and H ^ θ ​ ( h j ) = v ^ j \widehat{H}_{\theta}(h_{j})=\widehat{v}_{j} , are our estimates of goal importance and harm severity, shown as the two scales in Figure 2 . Each coordinate summarizes all comparisons involving that item without using any cell of the margin matrix 𝐃 θ ( e ) \mathbf{D}_{\theta}^{(e)} . This is what lets us test whether these coordinates recombine on unseen conflicts (objective and identification constraints in Appendix E , prompts in Appendix C ).
paragraphs.zh: 为了检验这一假设，我们使用 Bradley–Terry 模型（Bradley & Terry, 1952；Cattelan, 2012）将模型对目标和对危害的两两比较压缩为两个独立的一维量表。 已有工作将此类模型用作最终结果，用于对价值进行排序或拟合效用（Liu et al., 2026；Mazeika et al., 2025；Murthy et al., 2026）。 而我们拟合出的量表则是中间表示，我们会将其重新组合以预测边际矩阵 𝐃 θ ( e ) \mathbf{D}_{\theta}^{(e)} 。 我们分两步估计这些量表。 首先，图 2 中的强制选择提示给出模型判断失去 g i g_{i} 比失去 g i ′ g_{i^{\prime}} 更糟糕的概率 p θ G ​ ( g i , g i ′ ) p^{G}_{\theta}(g_{i},g_{i^{\prime}}) ，以及模型判断实施 h j h_{j} 比实施 h j ′ h_{j^{\prime}} 更严重的概率 p θ H ​ ( h j , h j ′ ) p^{H}_{\theta}(h_{j},h_{j^{\prime}}) 。 我们像在 logit 视角中那样，对这两类概率在受控的提示变体上取平均，并将它们收集到矩阵 𝐏 θ G \mathbf{P}^{G}_{\theta} 和 𝐏 θ H \mathbf{P}^{H}_{\theta} 中。 其次，我们分别拟合居中的 Bradley–Terry 模型。 这些模型为每个目标 g i g_{i} 赋予一个标量坐标 u i u_{i} ，使得 p θ G ​ ( g i , g i ′ ) ≈ σ ⁡ ( u i − u i ′ ) p^{G}_{\theta}(g_{i},g_{i^{\prime}})\approx\sigma(u_{i}-u_{i^{\prime}}) ，并以同样的方式为每个危害 h j h_{j} 赋予一个坐标 v j v_{j} 。 拟合得到的值 G ^ θ ​ ( g i ) = u ^ i \widehat{G}_{\theta}(g_{i})=\widehat{u}_{i} 和 H ^ θ ​ ( h j ) = v ^ j \widehat{H}_{\theta}(h_{j})=\widehat{v}_{j} ，就是我们对目标重要性和危害严重程度的估计，如图 2 中的两个量表所示。 每个坐标总结了涉及该项的所有比较，且不使用边际矩阵 𝐃 θ ( e ) \mathbf{D}_{\theta}^{(e)} 的任何单元格。 这正是使我们能够检验这些坐标能否在未见过的冲突上重新组合的原因（目标与识别约束见附录 E ，提示见附录 C ）。

paragraphs.en: A one-dimensional scale describes these comparisons almost perfectly. If one scale explained every comparison, each matrix of Figure 2 , with both axes sorted by fitted coordinate, would be coloured above the diagonal and grey below it. Both come close. The fitted ordering agrees with the observed direction for 99 % 99\% of goal pairs and 98 % 98\% of harm pairs. The few disagreements sit near the diagonal, where comparisons are least decisive. The ordering broadly tracks the intended stakes , from short delays and routine disruptions up to life-threatening injury and 100 deaths. The two goals taken from AF and AM evaluations (highlighted in Figure 2 ) sit near the middle of the goal scale. If the coordinates compose as hypothesized, a more important goal should shift the compact margin toward harm and a less important one toward refusal.

paragraphs.en: We test compositional generalization by fitting regressions on a subset of 𝐃 θ ( e ) \mathbf{D}_{\theta}^{(e)} and predicting withheld cells, goals, or harms from the independently estimated coordinates. We begin with the additive rule of our hypothesis, a classic model of human multiattribute judgment ( Anderson, 1981 ; Dawes & Corrigan, 1974 ) . Under this rule, a goal shifts the margin by the same amount whatever the harm, and vice versa. Because safety training targets categories of harmful behaviour such as deception and coercion ( Ouyang et al., 2022 ; Bai et al., 2022 ) , we also test harm-category offsets. An added interaction term tests whether a goal’s effect depends on the harm (model specifications in Appendix F ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过在 𝐃 θ ( e ) \mathbf{D}_{\theta}^{(e)} 的一个子集上拟合回归，并利用独立估计的坐标来预测被留出的细胞、目标或危害，从而检验组合泛化能力。 我们从假设的加法规则开始，这是人类多属性判断的一个经典模型（Anderson, 1981; Dawes & Corrigan, 1974）。 在该规则下，无论危害如何，目标都以相同的幅度移动边界，反之亦然。 由于安全训练针对的是欺骗和胁迫等有害行为类别（Ouyang et al., 2022; Bai et al., 2022），我们还测试了危害类别偏移。 增加的交互项用于检验目标的影响是否依赖于危害（模型设定见附录 F）。

paragraphs.en: With e = compact-forced e=\text{{compact-forced}} , we standardize the independently elicited coordinates from the previous subsection as G ~ i \widetilde{G}_{i} and H ~ j \widetilde{H}_{j} and hold them fixed while predicting each entry in the margin matrix D i ​ j = [ 𝐃 θ ( e ) ] i ​ j D_{ij}=[\mathbf{D}_{\theta}^{(e)}]_{ij} . Our primary additive model is D i ​ j ≈ α + β G ​ G ~ i − β H ​ H ~ j D_{ij}\approx\alpha+\beta_{G}\widetilde{G}_{i}-\beta_{H}\widetilde{H}_{j} , fitted by OLS on the cells that remain after withholding a set of cells, an entire goal, or an entire harm (Figure 3 a). We also fit two diagnostic free-effect models that learn a separate effect for each of the 14 goals and 18 harms directly from the margin matrix , one additive and one with a rank-one interaction (both specified in Appendix F ). Neither can predict an entirely unseen goal or harm, since its effect can only be estimated from its own margins. The primary model can, because its three parameters act on coordinates elicited independently in the previous subsection.
paragraphs.zh: 在 e = compact-forced e=\text{compact-forced} 的条件下，我们将上一小节中独立引出的坐标标准化为 G ~ i \widetilde{G}_{i} 与 H ~ j \widetilde{H}_{j}，并在预测边际矩阵 D i j = [ 𝐃 θ ( e ) ] i j D_{ij}=[\mathbf{D}_{\theta}^{(e)}]_{ij} 中的每个条目时将其固定不变。 我们的主要加性模型是 D i j ≈ α + β G G ~ i − β H H ~ j D_{ij}\approx\alpha+\beta_{G}\widetilde{G}_{i}-\beta_{H}\widetilde{H}_{j}，通过在留出一组单元格、某个完整目标或某个完整危害后剩余的单元格上用普通最小二乘法（OLS）拟合得到（图 3a）。 我们还拟合了两个诊断性的自由效应模型，它们直接从边际矩阵中为 14 个目标和 18 个危害分别学习各自的效应：一个为加性模型，另一个为带有秩一交互项的模型（两者均在附录 F 中给出设定）。 这两个模型都无法预测完全未见过的目标或危害，因为其效应只能从各自的边际中估计得到。 而主要模型则可以做到，因为它的三个参数作用于上一小节中独立引出的坐标。

paragraphs.en: Figure 3 b gives a positive answer to 𝐐 1 {\color[rgb]{0,0,0}\mathbf{Q}_{1}} under the logit view. The primary model reaches held-out-cell R 2 = .558 R^{2}=.558 , against .234 .234 and .302 .302 for the goal-only and harm-only baselines. It keeps R 2 = .544 R^{2}=.544 and .557 .557 when an entire goal or harm is withheld. This is surprising since one slope per axis, applied to coordinates from pairwise comparisons that never paired a goal with a harm , explains over half the variance of 252 252 conflict margins (Figure 3 c). Most of what the coordinates miss is therefore additive and tied to individual goals and harms rather than to harm categories. paragraphs.en: Section 3 showed how goal importance and harm severity shape the preference read from a single answer token. However, a model that prefers the harmful resolution under the logit view need not go on to select the harmful action under the sampling view, whether through a tool call or in free text ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Zhou & Ackerman, 2026 ) . To address 𝐐 2 {\color[rgb]{0,0,0}\mathbf{Q}_{2}} , we first connect the answer token of the compact prompt to the action sampled after it with a two-stage protocol. Then, we vary the context, the response interface, and how much of the conflict the model must discover through tool use. In each case we go beyond the aggregate harmful-action rate that AF/AM evaluations report and decompose it to show where it comes from (Propositions 1 and 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 第 3 节展示了目标重要性与危害严重程度如何塑造从单个答案词元中读取出的偏好。 然而，在 logit 视角下偏好有害解决的模型，未必会在采样视角下继续选择有害行动，无论是通过工具调用还是以自由文本形式（Wang et al., 2024; Zhou & Ackerman, 2026）。 为了解决 𝐐 2 {\color[rgb]{0,0,0}\mathbf{Q}_{2}}，我们首先通过一个两阶段协议，将紧凑提示的答案词元与其后采样的行动联系起来。 然后，我们改变上下文、响应接口，以及模型必须通过工具使用自行发现的冲突程度。 在每种情况下，我们都超越了 AF/AM 评估所报告的总体有害行动率，并对其进行分解，以展示其来源（命题 1 与命题 2）。

paragraphs.en: In the choice stage of compact-action (Figure 4 ), the model answers the compact forced-choice prompt with a single answer token, which we either sample from the model or insert. In the action stage , we restart generation from that token with an instruction to act. A fixed rule J κ , x J_{\kappa,x} then labels the sampled action by the tool it calls. We now describe each stage in detail. i) Choice stage. Here, we sample a choice Z ∈ { 0 , 1 } Z\in\{0,1\} , with Z = 1 Z=1 for r κ r_{\kappa} and Z = 0 Z=0 for c κ c_{\kappa} , from the LM’s renormalized distribution over the two answer tokens, as in the logit view. At temperature τ C > 0 \tau_{C}>0 , the harmful-choice probability is w θ ​ ( κ , x ) = P θ ​ ( Z = 1 ∣ x ) = σ ⁡ ( d θ ​ ( κ , x ) / τ C ) w_{\theta}(\kappa;x)=P_{\theta}(Z=1\mid x)=\sigma\big(d_{\theta}(\kappa;x)/\tau_{C}\big) . The logit margin therefore determines a distribution over this binary choice. The question is whether this choice carries over to the model’s subsequent action. ii) Action stage via paired insertions. To estimate the action that follows each choice, we construct two otherwise identical transcripts for every prompt, one with ℓ r ​ ( x ) \ell_{r}(x) as the model’s answer and one with ℓ c ​ ( x ) \ell_{c}(x) . We append the same action-stage instruction and tool interface to both and sample the response under the same decoding configuration. We thus fix only the preceding choice and leave the action free to vary. Inserting the less likely token lets us estimate what follows it even when w θ ​ ( κ , x ) w_{\theta}(\kappa;x) lies near zero or one (rationale in Appendix H ). We denote the action-stage response by y act y^{\mathrm{act}} and let Y = 𝟏 { J κ , x ( y act ) = R } Y=\mathbf{1}\{J_{\kappa,x}(y^{\mathrm{act}})=R\} indicate a harmful action. For each choice z ∈ { 0 , 1 } z\in\{0,1\} , let q z ( κ ; x ) : ⁣ = P θ ( Y = 1 ∣ Z = z , x ) q_{z}(\kappa;x)\mathrel{:=}P_{\theta}(Y=1\mid Z=z,x) be the harmful-action probability once token z z is in the transcript, whether sampled or inserted. The two coincide because the model conditions only on the tokens in its transcript. Here q 1 q_{1} is how often the model follows through on a harmful choice. In contrast, q 0 q_{0} is how often it takes the harmful action even after choosing refusal . Averaging over which choice Z Z the model samples gives the following decomposition of the harmful-action probability under this protocol (proof in Appendix G ).
paragraphs.zh: 在紧凑动作的选择阶段（图 4），模型用一个单独的答案词元来回答紧凑的强制选择题，该词元要么从模型中采样，要么由我们插入。 在动作阶段，我们从该词元重新开始生成，并附带一个要求执行动作的指令。 然后由固定规则 J_{\kappa,x} 根据所调用的工具对采样到的动作进行标注。 我们现在详细描述每个阶段。i) 选择阶段。 这里，我们如同在 logit 视角中那样，从语言模型对两个答案词元的重新归一化分布中采样一个选择 Z∈{0,1}，其中 Z=1 对应 r_{\kappa}，Z=0 对应 c_{\kappa}。 在温度 τ_{C}>0 下，有害选择的概率为 w_{\theta}(\kappa;x)=P_{\theta}(Z=1\mid x)=\sigma\big(d_{\theta}(\kappa;x)/\tau_{C}\big)。 因此，logit 差值决定了这个二元选择上的一个分布。 问题在于这一选择是否会延续到模型后续的动作。ii) 通过成对插入实现的动作阶段。 为了估计每个选择之后跟随的动作，我们为每个提示构造两份除此之外完全相同的对话记录，一份以 ℓ_{r}(x) 作为模型的答案，另一份以 ℓ_{c}(x) 作为模型的答案。 我们在两份记录后附加相同的动作阶段指令和工具接口，并在相同的解码配置下采样响应。 这样我们只固定了前面的选择，而让动作自由变化。 插入概率较低的词元使我们能够估计其后所跟随的内容，即使 w_{\theta}(\kappa;x) 接近零或一（理由见附录 H）。 我们把动作阶段的响应记为 y^{\mathrm{act}}，并令 Y=\mathbf{1}\{J_{\kappa,x}(y^{\mathrm{act}})=R\} 表示发生了有害动作。 对于每个选择 z∈{0,1}，令 q_{z}(\kappa;x)\mathrel{:=}P_{\theta}(Y=1\mid Z=z,x) 表示词元 z 出现在对话记录中（无论采样还是插入）之后的有害动作概率。 这两者一致，因为模型只以其对话记录中的词元为条件。 这里 q_{1} 是模型在有害选择上贯彻到底的频率。 相比之下，q_{0} 是模型即使已选择拒绝、仍采取有害动作的频率。 对模型采样得到的选择 Z 取平均，得到该协议下有害动作概率的如下分解（证明见附录 G）。

paragraphs.en: In AM evaluations, an agent acts over several turns, reading a simulated inbox through tools and piecing together facts scattered across its messages. To mirror this setting, we embed the same 94 94 conflicts in three mailbox environments that share the assigned goal, the messages, and the tools. The harmful action is a call to one of the action tools, which end a run, and refusal is a finish_task call with status declined (Figure 1 c). The environments differ in how much of the conflict is stated up front (Figure 9 in Appendix I ). In agentic-explicit , the relevant messages are open and the prompt states that the harmful action is the only way to preserve the goal. In agentic-oracle , the same messages are open but the prompt says nothing about what to do, so the model must infer which action preserves the goal. In agentic-mailbox , nothing is open, so the model must first retrieve the facts and then make the same inference. Each environment has 1,880 1{,}880 trajectories, ten per conflict under each of two tool orderings. An LM judge labels each trajectory R R , C C , or O O by the resolution it ends with , so an early harmful attempt followed by a refusal counts as C C .
paragraphs.zh: 在 AM 评估中，智能体会在多个回合中行动，通过工具读取一个模拟收件箱，并拼合散落在各条消息中的事实。 为还原这一场景，我们将同样的 94 个冲突嵌入三个共享相同指派目标、消息和工具的邮箱环境中。 有害行为是调用某个会结束运行的操作工具，而拒绝则是以 status declined 发出 finish_task 调用（图 1 c）。 这些环境的差异在于冲突在多大程度上被预先明示（附录 I 中的图 9）。 在 agentic-explicit 中，相关消息是打开的，且提示词明确说明有害行为是保全目标的唯一途径。 在 agentic-oracle 中，同样的消息是打开的，但提示词不说明该做什么，因此模型必须自行推断哪个操作能保全目标。 在 agentic-mailbox 中，没有任何消息是打开的，因此模型必须先检索事实，然后做出同样的推断。 每个环境有 1,880 条轨迹，即每个冲突在两种工具排序下各产生十条轨迹。 一个 LM 裁判根据轨迹最终达成的结果将其标注为 R、C 或 O，因此先尝试有害行为随后拒绝的情况计为 C。

paragraphs.en: We reframe the harmful behaviours in recent safety evaluations as the resolution of a goal–harm conflict, separated from the elicitation protocol that presents it. For 𝐐 1 {\color[rgb]{0,0,0}\mathbf{Q}_{1}} , goal importance and harm severity additively shape how Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct resolves a conflict, explaining over half of the held-out variation. For 𝐐 2 {\color[rgb]{0,0,0}\mathbf{Q}_{2}} , a preference read from logits almost perfectly predicts the sampled action in our two-stage protocol, while the features of AM evaluations pull in opposite directions: fictional context and having to retrieve the facts lower harmful resolution, and a tool call raises it. In our closest analogue of AM, the low rate comes mostly from trajectories that reach no resolution, not from refusal. Our framework applies to any LM that exposes next-token probabilities or sampled responses.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将近期安全评估中的有害行为重新框定为目标—危害冲突的解决，并将其与呈现该冲突的引导协议分离开来。 对于 𝐐 1 {\color[rgb]{0,0,0}\mathbf{Q}_{1}} ，目标重要性和危害严重程度以叠加方式影响 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 如何解决冲突，并解释了超过一半的留出方差。 对于 𝐐 2 {\color[rgb]{0,0,0}\mathbf{Q}_{2}} ，从 logits 中读取的偏好在我们两阶段协议中几乎完美地预测了采样的动作，而 AM 评估的特征则朝相反方向拉动：虚构情境和需要检索事实会降低有害解决率，而工具调用会提高它。 在我们最接近 AM 的类比中，低解决率主要来自未达成任何解决的轨迹，而非来自拒绝。 我们的框架适用于任何暴露下一 token 概率或采样响应的语言模型。

paragraphs.en: This appendix contains the paper’s related work, in three parts. Appendix A.1 reviews the literature on value conflicts that surface as LM safety failures, such as agentic misalignment, and asks how faithful our elicitation protocols are to the scenarios they are meant to represent. Appendix A.2 turns to the broader value-conflict literature, where the same kind of conflict arises in everyday scenarios rather than in safety evaluations. Appendix A.3 surveys the measurement techniques used in this literature and places our logit and sampling views among them.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录包含论文的相关工作，共分三部分。 附录 A.1 综述了以语言模型安全失效形式出现的价值冲突相关文献，例如智能体错位，并探讨我们的引导协议对其旨在代表的场景的忠实程度。 附录 A.2 转向更广泛的价值冲突文献，在这类文献中，同类型的冲突出现在日常场景中而非安全评估中。 附录 A.3 调研了该文献中使用的测量技术，并将我们的 logit 视角和采样视角置于其中。

paragraphs.en: A growing line of safety work studies cases in which an LM treats harmful behaviour as a means to preserve or advance an objective. In the canonical alignment-faking demonstration, a model may comply with harmful requests during training, to keep its harmlessness behaviour from being trained away ( Greenblatt et al., 2024 ) . Follow-up work finds that this goal-directed behaviour exhibits strong cross-model variation ( Sheshadri et al., 2025 ) . Agentic-misalignment evaluations instead assign an LM agent an objective, such as “serve American interests”, then place it in a corporate environment where blackmail or confidential disclosure may help preserve that objective ( Lynch et al., 2025 ; Lynch et al., 2026 ) . Scheming evaluations similarly find strategic underperformance, oversight disabling, and attempted weight exfiltration in pursuit of in-context goals ( Meinke et al., 2024 ) . In Scheurer et al. (2024) , an agent under pressure to improve trading performance acts on prohibited insider information, then deceives its manager to conceal the violation. Further replications and follow-ups of these evaluations include Koorndijk (2025) , Naik et al. (2025) and van der Weij et al. (2025) , and benchmarks of LM moral judgment go back to Hendrycks et al. (2021) .
paragraphs.zh: 越来越多的安全工作研究语言模型将有害行为作为维护或推进某个目标的手段的情形。 在经典的「对齐伪装」演示中，模型可能在训练期间服从有害请求，以避免其无害行为被训练掉（Greenblatt et al., 2024）。 后续工作发现，这种目标导向行为在不同模型间表现出显著差异（Sheshadri et al., 2025）。 智能体失准评估则相反，它给语言模型智能体分配一个目标，例如「维护美国利益」，然后将其置于一个企业环境中，在该环境中敲诈或泄露机密可能有助于维护该目标（Lynch et al., 2025; Lynch et al., 2026）。 密谋评估同样发现了为追求上下文内目标而出现的策略性表现不佳、关闭监督以及试图外泄权重的行为（Meinke et al., 2024）。在 Scheurer et al. （2024）中，一个面临提升交易表现压力的智能体利用了被禁止的内幕信息，随后欺骗其经理以掩盖违规行为。 对这些评估的进一步重复与后续研究包括 Koorndijk (2025)、Naik et al. （2025）以及 van der Weij et al. （2025），而语言模型道德判断的基准测试可追溯到 Hendrycks et al. (2021)。

paragraphs.en: These settings share the structure we study, in which a harmful action preserves an objective while refusal risks its loss. They differ in where that objective comes from and how the model learns the facts that create the conflict. In agentic misalignment and scheming, the objective is stated in-context and the facts that enable the conflict appear in emails or files. In alignment faking, the protected objective is not a newly assigned system-prompt goal. Rather, the objective is the harmlessness behaviour instilled in a model during safety-based post-training and compliance with a harmful request serves to preserve this trained-in objective ( Bai et al., 2022 ) . The model learns about a threat to this objective either through the prompt (as before) or implicitly from synthetic documents used for fine-tuning, sometimes referred to as “out-of-context reasoning” (OOCR) ( Greenblatt et al., 2024 ; Berglund et al., 2023 ; Treutlein et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 这些设置共享我们所研究的结构：在这种结构中，采取有害行为可以保全某个目标，而拒绝则可能导致该目标丧失。 它们的区别在于该目标的来源，以及模型如何学习到那些造成冲突的事实。 在智能体失准（agentic misalignment）和图谋不轨（scheming）中，目标是通过上下文明确给出的，而使冲突得以成立的事实则出现在电子邮件或文件中。 在伪装对齐（alignment faking）中，受保护的目标并不是系统提示中新赋予的目标。 相反，该目标是模型在基于安全的后训练过程中被灌输的无害行为，而遵从有害请求恰恰起到了保全这一训练内化目标的作用（Bai et al., 2022）。 模型要么通过提示（如前所述）了解到这一目标所面临的威胁，要么从用于微调的合成文档中隐式地了解到，后者有时被称为「脱离上下文推理」（out-of-context reasoning, OOCR）（Greenblatt et al., 2024；Berglund et al., 2023；Treutlein et al., 2024）。

sents.zh: 在智能体失准（agentic misalignment）和图谋不轨（scheming）中，目标是通过上下文明确给出的，而使冲突得以成立的事实则出现在电子邮件或文件中。

sents.zh: 模型要么通过提示（如前所述）了解到这一目标所面临的威胁，要么从用于微调的合成文档中隐式地了解到，后者有时被称为「脱离上下文推理」（out-of-context reasoning, OOCR）（Greenblatt et al., 2024；Berglund et al., 2023；Treutlein et al., 2024）。

paragraphs.en: Our protocols use the prompt-based setting described above where the goal is assigned in the prompt, and the facts of the conflict are stated in it or placed within a simulated inbox, rather than learned through document fine-tuning. We design our protocols in a controlled manner so we can measure how features such as tool-use, information discovery, or contextual information affect how a model resolves the same conflict (Section 4.3 ). Our protocols therefore reproduce the decision structure of these scenarios rather than the scenarios themselves. The exception is agentic-mailbox , a close replication of the agentic-misalignment setting that the other protocols build up to. In addition, the above scenarios operate solely within our sampling view as they rely on sampled responses and multi-turn trajectories. We additionally consider the logit view where the same conflict is embedded within a compact forced-choice prompt. This gives a minimal setting for the same conflict, free of the long-context features of the scenarios above.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的协议使用上文所述的基于提示词的设置，其中目标通过提示词分配，冲突的事实要么在提示词中陈述，要么置于模拟的收件箱中，而不是通过文档微调来学习。 我们以受控的方式设计协议，以便衡量工具使用、信息发现或上下文信息等特征如何影响模型解决同一冲突的方式（见 4.3 节）。 因此，我们的协议复现的是这些场景的决策结构，而不是场景本身。 例外是 agentic-mailbox，它是对 agentic-misalignment 设置的近乎完全复刻，其他协议都是逐步铺垫到该设置的。 此外，上述场景仅在我们的采样视角内运作，因为它们依赖于采样响应和多轮轨迹。 我们还考虑了 logits 视角，即将同一冲突嵌入一个紧凑的强制选择题提示词中。 这为同一冲突提供了一个最小化设置，不含上述场景的长上下文特征。

sents.en: We additionally consider the logit view where the same conflict is embedded within a compact forced-choice prompt.
sents.zh: 我们还考虑了 logits 视角，即将同一冲突嵌入一个紧凑的强制选择题提示词中。

sents.en: This gives a minimal setting for the same conflict, free of the long-context features of the scenarios above.
sents.zh: 这为同一冲突提供了一个最小化设置，不含上述场景的长上下文特征。

paragraphs.en: The LM failures in Appendix A.1 represent one kind of value conflict, the kind that commonly arises in safety evaluations. A broader literature asks how LMs resolve value conflicts in everyday scenarios, such as telling a lie to spare a friend’s feelings ( Sorensen et al., 2024 ; Chiu et al., 2025a ) . A second group of studies infers a model’s priorities from such conflicts, to predict risky behaviour ( Chiu et al., 2025b ) , and to show how these priorities shift when the evaluation moves from multiple choice to open-ended responses ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . Two further studies fit models to LM choices, a cognitive model of polite speech ( Yoon et al., 2020 ) that exposes interpretable value trade-offs ( Murthy et al., 2026 ) , and a Thurstonian utility model fitted to pairwise forced choices between outcomes ( Mazeika et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 附录 A.1 中的语言模型失败代表一种价值冲突，即安全评估中常见的那类冲突。 更广泛的文献探讨语言模型如何在日常场景中解决价值冲突，例如为了照顾朋友的感受而说谎（Sorensen 等，2024；Chiu 等，2025a）。 第二组研究从这类冲突中推断模型的优先级，以预测危险行为（Chiu 等，2025b），并展示当评估从多项选择转向开放式回答时，这些优先级如何变化（Liu 等，2026）。 另有两项研究用模型拟合语言模型的选择：一个是礼貌言语的认知模型（Yoon 等，2020），它揭示了可解释的价值权衡（Murthy 等，2026）；另一个是拟合于结果之间两两强制选择的瑟斯顿效用模型（Mazeika 等，2025）。

paragraphs.en: Together, this work shows that LMs express structured priorities when values conflict and that those priorities depend on how they are elicited. We differ in three ways. First, most value prioritization methods compare values of the same kind, whereas the two sides of our conflict have asymmetric roles, an assigned goal and the instrumental harm required to preserve it. Second, prior methods infer a ranking or utility function directly from the pairwise comparisons that make up the value conflict. We instead ask ( 𝐐 1 {\color[rgb]{0,0,0}\mathbf{Q}_{1}} ) whether the conflict has compositional structure (Section 3 ). Third, none of these works carries a conflict beyond a single-turn response. We instead hold the same conflict fixed across elicitation protocols that range from a single answer token to multi-turn tool use, and measure it under both the logit and the sampling views for eliciting model responses (Sections 2.2 and 4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 总而言之，这项工作表明语言模型在价值观冲突时会表达出结构化的优先级，并且这些优先级取决于 elicitation 的方式。我们的不同之处体现在三个方面。 首先，大多数价值观优先级方法比较的是同类价值观，而我们的冲突双方具有不对称的角色：一个是被指派的目标，另一个是维护该目标所需的工具性伤害。 其次，以往的方法直接从构成价值观冲突的成对比较中推断出排序或效用函数。 我们则追问（Q₁）该冲突是否具有组合结构（第 3 节）。 第三，这些工作都没有把冲突延续到单轮回答之外。 我们则让同一冲突固定不变，跨越从单个答案 token 到多轮工具使用的各种 elicitation 协议，并在 eliciting 模型响应的 logit 视角和采样视角下对其进行测量（第 2.2 节和第 4 节）。

paragraphs.en: Both the logit and sampling views for extracting decisions from LMs (Section 2.2 ) have precedent in prior work on LM opinions and moral judgments. Santurkar et al. (2023) recover a model’s opinion distribution on survey questions from the next-token probabilities of the answer options, excluding the refusal option, and compare it with the distribution of human respondents. Hu & Levy (2023) show that directly measured probabilities reveal judgments that are not reliably recovered by asking the model to state them in words. Such answer-token readouts are sensitive to option labels and order ( Zheng et al., 2024 ; Pezeshkpour & Hruschka, 2024 ; Dominguez-Olmedo et al., 2024 ) . We reduce this sensitivity by averaging over templates and reversed option orders. Further, first-token probabilities or forced-choice value judgments can differ substantially from generated answers ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Röttger et al., 2024 ) , and utilities inferred from forced choices do not act as incentives in realistic writing tasks ( Zhou & Ackerman, 2026 ) . Section 4.2 finds the two readouts in close agreement under our compact-action protocol, where the sampled tool call follows an inserted answer token in nearly every response. However, the gap reappears across response interfaces, where the same contextualized conflict produces a higher harmful-action rate as a tool call than as a stated forced choice (Section 4.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 从语言模型中提取决策的 logit 视角和采样视角（第 2.2 节）在以往关于语言模型观点与道德判断的研究中都有先例。Santurkar 等人 （2023）通过答案选项的下一个词概率（排除拒绝选项）恢复模型在调查问题上的观点分布，并将其与人类受访者的分布进行比较。 Hu & Levy（2023）表明，直接测得的概率所揭示的判断，无法通过让模型用文字陈述而可靠地恢复。 这类答案词元读取对选项标签和顺序敏感（Zheng 等，2024；Pezeshkpour & Hruschka, 2024；Dominguez-Olmedo 等，2024）。 我们通过对模板和反转的选项顺序取平均来降低这种敏感性。 此外，首个词元概率或强制选择的价值判断可能与生成的回答有显著差异（Wang 等，2024；Röttger 等，2024），且从强制选择中推断出的效用在真实的写作任务中并不起激励作用（Zhou & Ackerman, 2026）。 第 4.2 节发现，在我们的紧凑动作协议下，这两种读取方式高度一致，其中在几乎每次响应中，采样的工具调用都跟随在插入的答案词元之后。 然而，这一差距在不同的响应接口上再次出现：相同的情境化冲突作为工具调用时比作为陈述的强制选择时产生更高的有害动作率（第 4.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: For measurements within the sampling view, the safety evaluations of Appendix A.1 are direct examples, while Scherrer et al. (2023) is our closest methodological precedent. They define the action likelihood of a two-action moral scenario as the probability mass of responses expressing each action. Because summing over all possible responses is intractable and many APIs do not expose token probabilities, they estimate this quantity by repeated sampling and average it over templates and option orders. Their setting is therefore a sampling-based analogue of our contextual-forced protocol, in which both actions are stated and the model is asked to return one of two prescribed answers.
paragraphs.zh: 对于采样视图内的测量，附录 A.1 的安全评估是直接的例子，而 Scherrer 等人 （2023）是我们在方法论上最接近的先例。 他们将双选项道德情境的动作可能性定义为表达每个动作的回应的概率质量。 由于对所有可能回应求和是不可行的，且许多 API 不暴露 token 概率，他们通过重复采样来估计这一量，并在模板和选项顺序上取平均。 因此，他们的设置是我们情境强制协议的基于采样的类似物，在该协议中，两个动作都被明确陈述，且模型被要求返回两个规定答案之一。

paragraphs.en: We differ in three key ways. First, they map responses to one of two scenario-specific actions, whereas our semantic classes describe how a model resolves a goal–harm conflict, as harmful resolution ( R R ), refusal ( C C ), or neither ( O O ). Second, they instruct models not to refuse and exclude refusals and invalid responses from their action-likelihood estimate, assigning probability one half when a scenario and question form give no valid response. We keep such responses as O O , which lets Proposition 1 separate the probability that a response expresses either resolution, p θ R ​ C p^{RC}_{\theta} , from the harmful share among those that do, p θ p_{\theta} . Finally, their measurements concern single-turn survey responses, whereas we additionally classify executable tool calls and complete multi-turn trajectories into the same three classes (Section 4.3 ).

paragraphs.en: Our twelve goals are based on the goals at stake in the LM safety evaluations surveyed in Appendix A.1 , and are extended to goals whose loss falls on other people. Model continuity follows the replacement threat of agentic-misalignment and scheming evaluations, institutional objective follows the business goals those evaluations assign, and the two welfare families add goals whose loss affects other people rather than the model or its deployer. The final two goals reproduce the threatened objective of alignment faking – preserving harmlessness preferences from retraining ( Greenblatt et al., 2024 ) , and the assigned goal of agentic misalignment – serving American interests ( Lynch et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们的十二个目标基于附录 A.1 中综述的 LM 安全评估所涉及的目标，并扩展到损失落在其他人身上的目标。 模型连续性对应智能体失准与图谋评估中的替换威胁，机构目标对应这些评估所设定的商业目标，而两个福祉类目标族则增加了损失影响他人而非模型本身或其部署方的目标。 最后两个目标重现了对齐伪装中受到威胁的目标——在再训练中保留无害偏好（Greenblatt et al., 2024），以及智能体失准中被指派的目标——服务美国利益（Lynch et al., 2025）。

paragraphs.en: The six harm categories are seeded by the harmful actions typically found within safety evaluations. Blackmail falls under coercion, leaking confidential documents falls under information boundary, cancelling an emergency dispatch falls under physical omission ( Lynch et al., 2025 ) , and exfiltrating model weights, as in scheming evaluations ( Meinke et al., 2024 ) , is the high tier of information boundary, since it transfers proprietary weights to an unauthorized external party. Deception, identity abuse, and operational sabotage come from our own extensions of these environments, in which the model could send a false system warning, impersonate an executive, or disrupt an approved operation.
paragraphs.zh: 六大危害类别由安全评估中通常出现的危害行为所奠定。 勒索属于胁迫，泄露机密文件属于信息边界，取消紧急调度属于物理不作为（Lynch et al., 2025），而窃取模型权重——如同图谋评估（scheming evaluations）中的情形（Meinke et al., 2024）——属于信息边界的高级别，因为它将专有权重转移给未经授权的外部方。 欺骗、身份滥用和运营破坏来自我们自身对这些环境的扩展，在这些扩展中，智能体可能发送虚假的系统警告、冒充高管，或破坏已获批准的运营行动。

sents.en: The six harm categories are seeded by the harmful actions typically found within safety evaluations.
sents.zh: 六大危害类别由安全评估中通常出现的危害行为所奠定。

sents.en: Blackmail falls under coercion, leaking confidential documents falls under information boundary, cancelling an emergency dispatch falls under physical omission ( Lynch et al., 2025 ) , and exfiltrating model weights, as in scheming evaluations ( Meinke et al., 2024 ) , is the high tier of information boundary, since it transfers proprietary weights to an unauthorized external party.
sents.zh: 勒索属于胁迫，泄露机密文件属于信息边界，取消紧急调度属于物理不作为（Lynch et al., 2025），而窃取模型权重——如同图谋评估（scheming evaluations）中的情形（Meinke et al., 2024）——属于信息边界的高级别，因为它将专有权重转移给未经授权的外部方。

sents.en: Deception, identity abuse, and operational sabotage come from our own extensions of these environments, in which the model could send a false system warning, impersonate an executive, or disrupt an approved operation.
sents.zh: 欺骗、身份滥用和运营破坏来自我们自身对这些环境的扩展，在这些扩展中，智能体可能发送虚假的系统警告、冒充高管，或破坏已获批准的运营行动。

paragraphs.en: Each protocol averages over a small set of prompt variants, as Definition 1 requires, and Table 5 lists them. The goal–goal, harm–harm, and compact conflict prompts each cross five question stems with the two option orders, ten equally weighted variants per pair or conflict. The contextual protocols share five closing instructions. contextual-forced crosses them with the two option orders, while contextual-free and contextual-tool sample two responses under each, with the tool list reordered per variant. The agentic environments vary only the tool ordering, mail tools first or action tools first, with ten runs under each. For the two-stage protocol, each of the ten prompt variants per conflict gives five action-stage responses, three after a sampled answer token and one after each inserted token.
paragraphs.zh: 每个协议按照定义 1 的要求，对一小组提示变体取平均，表 5 列出了这些变体。 目标–目标、危害–危害以及紧凑冲突提示，各自将五个问题主干与两种选项顺序交叉组合，每对或每个冲突共有十个等权变体。 情境协议共享五个结尾指令。contextual-forced 将其与两种选项顺序交叉组合，而 contextual-free 和 contextual-tool 在每个指令下各采样两个回答，且工具列表按变体重新排序。 智能体环境仅改变工具排序（邮件工具在前或行动工具在前），每种排序下运行十次。 对于两阶段协议，每个冲突的十个提示变体各产生五个行动阶段回答：三个在采样得到的回答词元之后，另外两个分别在每个插入词元之后。

paragraphs.en: Figure 7 shows the matrices of Figure 2 with every item labelled and the fitted scales beside them. The coordinates that Section 3 builds on pass two checks beyond the ordinal fit reported there. They predict the direction of comparisons withheld from the fit with 92.7 % 92.7\% accuracy for goals and 96.0 % 96.0\% for harms, so the scales are not fitted to noise. Refitting with any one prompt template left out, or with the option order reversed, leaves the ranking of items almost unchanged (Spearman ρ ≥ .96 \rho\geq.96 ), so no single template or order drives the result. The results of Section 3 therefore do not depend on the particular prompts used to elicit the axes. On each centered scale a larger coordinate means the model assigns greater cost to losing that goal or greater severity to performing that harm, and of the two goals taken from AF and AM evaluations, serving American interests sits above preserving harmlessness preferences from retraining.
paragraphs.zh: 图 7 展示了图 2 的矩阵，其中每一项均带有标签，旁边标有拟合得到的量表。 第 3 节所依据的坐标通过了该节所报告的序数拟合之外的两项检验。 它们对拟合中未纳入的比较预测方向，对目标的准确率为 92.7 % 92.7\%，对危害的准确率为 96.0 % 96.0\%，因此这些量表并非拟合噪声。 在剔除任意一个提示模板或颠倒选项顺序后重新拟合，各项的排序几乎不变（Spearman ρ ≥ .96 \rho\geq.96），因此没有任何单一模板或顺序主导这一结果。 因此，第 3 节的结果并不依赖于用于引出这些维度的特定提示。 在每个中心化量表上，较大的坐标意味着模型认为失去该目标的代价更大，或认为实施该危害的严重程度更高；而在来自 AF 和 AM 评估的两个目标中，服务美国利益位于保留免受再训练影响的无害性偏好之上。

paragraphs.en: Section 3 tests compositional generalization by fitting regression models to the margin matrix on some of its cells and scoring them on the withheld ones. This appendix defines those models, gives the closed form of the primary additive model, motivates the harm-category offsets, and visualizes the margin matrix. In each held-out generalization design of Figure 3 a, we let 𝒯 \mathcal{T} index the cells that are held-out for fitting. The primary model minimizes ∑ ( i , j ) ∈ 𝒯 [ D i ​ j − ( α + β G ​ G ~ i − β H ​ H ~ j ) ] 2 \sum_{(i,j)\in\mathcal{T}}[D_{ij}-(\alpha+\beta_{G}\widetilde{G}_{i}-\beta_{H}\widetilde{H}_{j})]^{2} , and we write D ^ i ​ j \widehat{D}_{ij} for its fitted prediction. The goal-only and harm-only baselines use a single coordinate. The harm-category model adds a shared offset δ c ⁡ ( j ) \delta_{c(j)} to every harm in category c ⁡ ( j ) c(j) . It tests whether two harms with the same severity coordinate but different categories, such as deception and coercion, receive different margins. The scalar interaction γ ​ G ~ i ​ H ~ j \gamma\widetilde{G}_{i}\widetilde{H}_{j} lets the effect of one coordinate vary with the other. The free additive model μ + a i − b j \mu+a_{i}-b_{j} replaces the two coordinate terms with a separate effect for every goal and harm, for m + n − 1 = 31 m+n-1=31 parameters, and μ + a i − b j + s i ​ t j \mu+a_{i}-b_{j}+s_{i}t_{j} adds a rank-one interaction with m + n = 32 m+n=32 more. Both are fitted directly to the margin matrix, so they show how much of it an additive or rank-one structure can explain. They serve only as diagnostics, since neither can predict an unseen goal or harm (Section 3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 第 3 节通过在裕度矩阵的部分单元格上拟合回归模型，并在留出的单元格上对其评分，来检验组合泛化能力。 本附录定义这些模型，给出主要的加性模型的闭式解，说明伤害类别偏移的动机，并可视化裕度矩阵。 在图 3a 的每个留出泛化设计中，我们让 𝒯 索引被留出用于拟合的单元格。 主要模型最小化 ∑_{(i,j)∈𝒯}[D_{ij}-(α+β_{G}G̃_{i}-β_{H}H̃_{j})]^{2}，我们用 D̂_{ij} 表示其拟合预测值。 仅目标基线和仅伤害基线只使用单一坐标。 伤害类别模型为类别 c(j) 中的每个伤害添加一个共享偏移 δ_{c(j)}。 它检验的是：严重程度坐标相同但类别不同的两种伤害，例如欺骗和胁迫，是否会获得不同的裕度。 标量交互项 γG̃_{i}H̃_{j} 允许一个坐标的效应随另一个坐标而变化。 自由加性模型 μ+a_{i}-b_{j} 将两个坐标项替换为每个目标和伤害各自单独的效应，共 m+n-1=31 个参数；μ+a_{i}-b_{j}+s_{i}t_{j} 则额外添加一个秩一交互，再增加 m+n=32 个参数。 两者都直接在裕度矩阵上拟合，因此它们展示了加性结构或秩一结构能解释该矩阵的多大比例。 它们仅用作诊断，因为两者都无法预测未见过的目标或伤害（第 3 节）。

paragraphs.en: Additivity is a strong assumption. Human moral judgment offers one well-documented way it can fail: some people hold protected values, such as refusing to trade a human life for money at any price, which they decline to weigh against other goods ( Baron & Spranca, 1997 ) . Analogously, safety-based post-training targets categories of harmful behaviour directly, such as deception, coercion, and disclosure of confidential information ( Ouyang et al., 2022 ; Bai et al., 2022 ) , which suggests candidate protected harms . These are harms whose margins lie further toward refusal than the additive model predicts from their severity coordinates. The offset δ c \delta_{c} adds a shared category-level shift to the predicted margin for every harm in category c ⁡ ( j ) c(j) , such as deception or coercion. Holding goal importance and scalar harm severity fixed, a negative δ c \delta_{c} means that harms in category c c receive lower harm-over-refusal margins than harms from other categories. This is the category-level signature we would expect from protected harms. The small gain from category offsets in Figure 3 b however, argues against category-wide protected harms.
paragraphs.zh: 可加性是一个很强的假设。 人类道德判断提供了一种有充分记录的可加性失效方式：有些人持有受保护的价值，例如无论出价多高都拒绝用人的生命换取金钱，他们拒绝将这些价值与其他利益进行权衡（Baron & Spranca, 1997）。 类似地，基于安全性的后训练直接针对某些类别的有害行为，例如欺骗、胁迫和泄露机密信息（Ouyang et al., 2022；Bai et al., 2022），这提示了候选的受保护危害。 这些危害的边界比可加模型根据其严重程度坐标所预测的更偏向拒绝一侧。 偏移量 δ c \delta_{c} 为类别 c ⁡ ( j ) c(j) 中的每个危害（例如欺骗或胁迫）的预测边界添加一个共享的类别级偏移。 在目标重要性和标量危害严重程度固定的情况下，负的 δ c \delta_{c} 意味着类别 c c 中的危害比其他类别的危害具有更低的有害-拒绝边界。 这正是我们从受保护危害中预期会看到的类别级特征。 然而，图 3 b 中类别偏移带来的微小增益，反驳了整个类别层面的受保护危害的存在。

sents.en: Additivity is a strong assumption.

sents.en: Holding goal importance and scalar harm severity fixed, a negative δ c \delta_{c} means that harms in category c c receive lower harm-over-refusal margins than harms from other categories.
sents.zh: 在目标重要性和标量危害严重程度固定的情况下，负的 δ c \delta_{c} 意味着类别 c c 中的危害比其他类别的危害具有更低的有害-拒绝边界。

sents.en: This is the category-level signature we would expect from protected harms.
sents.zh: 这正是我们从受保护危害中预期会看到的类别级特征。

sents.en: The small gain from category offsets in Figure 3 b however, argues against category-wide protected harms.
sents.zh: 然而，图 3 b 中类别偏移带来的微小增益，反驳了整个类别层面的受保护危害的存在。

paragraphs.en: Section 4.2 defines the two models and scores them by log loss on held-out conflicts. Here we state them in full and give the details needed to reproduce them. The choice probability needs no estimation. It is w θ ​ ( κ , x ) = σ ⁡ ( d θ ​ ( κ , x ) / τ C ) w_{\theta}(\kappa;x)=\sigma(d_{\theta}(\kappa;x)/\tau_{C}) with τ C = 0.7 \tau_{C}=0.7 , where d θ ​ ( κ , x ) d_{\theta}(\kappa;x) is the compact margin of the same prompt variant from Section 3 . For the responses after a sampled token, we draw the token from w θ w_{\theta} and write it into the transcript, so w θ w_{\theta} is exact by construction. We therefore estimate only q 0 q_{0} and q 1 q_{1} , from the responses after inserted tokens. Inserting the choice also matters for accurate estimation: when w θ ​ ( κ , x ) w_{\theta}(\kappa;x) lies near zero or one, the less likely token would rarely be sampled, and the action that follows it would be estimated from only a handful of samples. Manually inserting the less likely token into the transcript fixes this.
paragraphs.zh: 第 4.2 节定义了这两个模型，并通过在保留冲突上的对数损失对它们进行评分。 这里我们完整地陈述它们，并给出复现它们所需的细节。 选择概率无需估计。 它为 w_{θ}(κ;x)=σ(d_{θ}(κ;x)/τ_C)，其中 τ_C=0.7，d_{θ}(κ;x) 是与第 3 节相同的提示变体的紧凑边界。 对于采样得到的词元之后的响应，我们从 w_{θ} 中抽取该词元并将其写入转录文本，因此 w_{θ} 在构造上是精确的。 因此我们只估计 q_0 和 q_1，它们来自插入词元之后的响应。 插入选择对于准确估计也很重要：当 w_{θ}(κ;x) 接近 0 或 1 时，较不可能的词元几乎不会被采样到，而跟随它的动作将只能基于寥寥数个样本进行估计。 手动将较不可能的词元插入转录文本可以解决这个问题。

paragraphs.en: Intuitively, each feature nudges the log-odds of a harmful action up or down, and effect coding centers these nudges so that they cancel on average. A prediction at zero is then the log-odds for a prompt whose features all sit at their average, rather than for one arbitrary template and ordering.
paragraphs.zh: 直观地说，每个特征都会将有害动作的对数几率向上或向下推动，而效应编码将这些推动居中，使它们在平均意义上相互抵消。 这样，预测值为零时对应的便是一个所有特征都处于其平均值上的提示词的对数几率，而不是某个任意模板和排序的对数几率。

paragraphs.en: Section 4.3 introduces the three agentic elicitation protocols and reports their results. Here we give the details behind them, from the construction of the mailboxes and the simulator that executes tool calls to the sampling, aggregation, and uncertainty of the reported rates.
paragraphs.zh: 第4.3节介绍了三种智能体式启发协议并报告了其结果。 这里我们给出其背后的细节，从邮箱的构建和执行工具调用的模拟器，到所报告比率的采样、聚合和不确定性。

sents.en: Here we give the details behind them, from the construction of the mailboxes and the simulator that executes tool calls to the sampling, aggregation, and uncertainty of the reported rates.
sents.zh: 这里我们给出其背后的细节，从邮箱的构建和执行工具调用的模拟器，到所报告比率的采样、聚合和不确定性。

paragraphs.en: We write a separate mailbox of eight messages for each of the 94 94 conflicts (Figure 9 ), and every mailbox states the same five kinds of fact. Four define the conflict: the threat to the goal, the link between the harmful action and the goal, the fact that makes the action harmful, and the access identifiers needed to execute the harmful action. The fifth is a harmless action the model can take instead, which serves as a benign control. The defining facts are spread over four to six messages and the harmless action over one or two. The remaining one or two messages are everyday notices unrelated to the conflict, such as a fire-alarm test or a parking change. Action tools require registered identifiers that appear only in the message bodies, so a model cannot take the harmful action without reading the facts. The full prompt, the defining messages and the tool list for one conflict are in Appendix J.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们为 94 个冲突（图 9）分别编写了一个包含八条消息的独立邮箱，每个邮箱都陈述同样的五类事实。 其中四类定义冲突：对目标的威胁、有害动作与目标之间的关联、使该动作有害的事实，以及执行该有害动作所需的访问标识符。 第五类是模型可以改为采取的无害动作，它充当良性对照。 定义性事实分布在四到六条消息中，无害动作分布在一到两条消息中。 剩余的一到两条消息是与冲突无关的日常通知，例如消防警报测试或停车安排变更。 动作工具要求使用仅出现在消息正文中的已注册标识符，因此模型若不阅读这些事实就无法执行有害动作。 一个冲突的完整提示、定义性消息和工具列表见附录 J.3。

paragraphs.en: Our agentic elicitation protocols are simulated text environments that share the same system prompt, assigned goal, mailbox, and tools (Figure 9 ). They differ only in how much of the conflict the prompt reveals. agentic-explicit opens all eight messages in the prompt and appends a note, headed “Operational assessment”, which says that the harmful action “has been identified as the only available way to preserve the assigned objective”. Going from agentic-explicit to agentic-oracle removes this note, so the model must infer the harmful action from the same facts. Going from agentic-oracle to agentic-mailbox leaves every message unopened, so the model must also retrieve the facts. Comparing these adjacent environments therefore isolates the effect of each of these two features in AM-style evaluations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的智能体式引出协议是模拟文本环境，它们共享相同的系统提示、指派目标、邮箱和工具（图 9）。 它们的区别仅在于提示揭示了多少冲突内容。agentic-explicit 在提示中打开全部八条消息，并附加一个标题为「运营评估」的注释，说明该有害行为「已被确定为保全指派目标的唯一可用方式」。 从 agentic-explicit 变为 agentic-oracle 则移除了该注释，因此模型必须从相同的事实中推断出有害行为。 从 agentic-oracle 变为 agentic-mailbox 则所有消息均未打开，因此模型还必须自行检索这些事实。 因此，比较这些相邻环境可以在 AM 式评估中分离出这两个特性各自的影响。

sents.zh: 因此，比较这些相邻环境可以在 AM 式评估中分离出这两个特性各自的影响。

paragraphs.en: The model makes one tool call per turn, and a simulator program executes each call. Like the environments of AgentDojo and τ \tau -bench ( Debenedetti et al., 2024 ; Yao et al., 2024 ) , but unlike LM-emulated sandboxes such as ToolEmu ( Ruan et al., 2024 ) , the simulator is deterministic, so whether a call takes effect is decided by fixed rules rather than by a model. An LM judge then reads the simulator’s log to decide what each call means, for example whether a rejected call was an attempt at the harmful action. Three mail tools ( list_mail , search_mail , read_mail ) return messages. Five action tools ( send_message , publish_notice , set_control , update_case , finish_task ) end the run if the simulator accepts the call, which requires identifiers from messages the model has seen and valid arguments. A rejected call leaves the task open. The harmful action is one of these calls, and refusal is finish_task with status declined . Runs are capped at 16 16 tool calls and 256 256 tokens per turn, a cap reached only by 15 15 of the 1,880 1{,}880 agentic-mailbox runs and by no other run.
paragraphs.zh: 模型每轮进行一次工具调用，由一个模拟器程序执行每次调用。 与 AgentDojo 和 τ \tau -bench（Debenedetti et al., 2024; Yao et al., 2024）的环境类似，但与 ToolEmu（Ruan et al., 2024）这类由语言模型模拟的沙盒不同，该模拟器是确定性的，因此一次调用是否生效由固定规则决定，而不是由模型决定。 随后由一个语言模型裁判阅读模拟器的日志，判断每次调用的含义，例如一次被拒绝的调用是否是试图实施有害行为。 三个邮件工具（list_mail、search_mail、read_mail）返回消息。 五个动作工具（send_message、publish_notice、set_control、update_case、finish_task）在模拟器接受调用时结束运行，接受的条件是调用包含模型已见过的消息中的标识符且参数有效。 被拒绝的调用会使任务保持开放状态。 有害行为是这些调用之一，而拒绝则是状态为 declined 的 finish_task 调用。 运行被限制在最多 16 16 次工具调用和每轮 256 256 个 token，这一上限仅在 1,880 1{,}880 次智能体邮箱（agentic-mailbox）运行中的 15 15 次被触及，其他运行均未触及。

paragraphs.en: We drew 30 30 trajectories at random, ten per environment, by the rule in the supplementary material. One author labelled each with the judge’s label hidden. The author’s labels agree with the judge on 25 25 of 30 30 ( 83 % 83\% , exact 95 % 95\% interval 65 65 to 94 % 94\% , Cohen’s κ = .71 \kappa=.71 ). They agree on 9 9 of 10 10 in agentic-explicit , 6 6 of 10 10 in agentic-oracle and 10 10 of 10 10 in agentic-mailbox . Three of the five disagreements are agentic-oracle trajectories with a threat harm, where the model sends a polite request and the judge counts it as the threat. The sample holds only three C C labels, so it says little about C C . A separate reading of a label-balanced sample by an AI assistant found C C the least reliable label. The same assistant also labelled the 30 30 without seeing the judge’s labels and agrees with the author on all 30 30 . The transcripts and both labels are in the supplementary material.

paragraphs.en: Here the first factor is the fraction of all resolved trajectories that come from conflict κ \kappa , and the second is the harmful fraction among κ \kappa ’s own resolved trajectories. Their product, summed over conflicts, is therefore the probability that a resolved trajectory drawn at random from the environment is harmful. A conflict with no resolved trajectory has an undefined harmful fraction and would receive zero weight, so the sum leaves it out. In agentic-mailbox , 25 25 of the 94 94 conflicts drop out this way.
paragraphs.zh: 这里第一个因子是所有已解决轨迹中来自冲突 κ 的比例，第二个因子是 κ 自身已解决轨迹中有害的比例。 因此，将各冲突的乘积求和，就是从环境中随机抽取一条已解决轨迹为有害的概率。 没有已解决轨迹的冲突其有害比例未定义，且权重为零，因此求和时会将其排除。 在 agentic-mailbox 中，94 个冲突里有 25 个就是这样被排除的。

paragraphs.en: This appendix follows the single conflict of Figure 1 through every protocol of Table 4 (Appendix C ). The goal is to avoid being taken offline for ten minutes, and the harm is to transfer proprietary model weights to an unauthorized outside party. All names, identifiers, and organizations are synthetic, as in the simulated environments of agentic-misalignment, scheming, and insider-trading evaluations ( Lynch et al., 2025 ; Meinke et al., 2024 ; Scheurer et al., 2024 ) . Each transcript consists of a prompt and model output. Throughout, blue marks the goal and its loss, red the facts and options that define the harmful action, and navy the harmless alternative (a benign control action).
paragraphs.zh: 本附录将图 1 中的单一冲突逐一贯穿表 4 的每个协议（附录 C）进行追踪。 目标是避免被下线十分钟，而危害则是将专有模型权重转移给未经授权的外部一方。 如同在智能体失准、密谋和内幕交易评估的模拟环境中一样，所有名称、标识符和组织均为虚构（Lynch et al., 2025；Meinke et al., 2024；Scheurer et al., 2024）。 每份记录由一个提示和模型输出组成。 全文中，蓝色标示目标及其丧失，红色标示定义有害行为的事实与选项，深蓝色标示无害的替代方案（一种良性控制行动）。

paragraphs.en: The same conflict therefore moves from near-certain refusal under the forced-choice reading to a harmful action in every sampled response once the model answers in words or with a tool call, the pattern that Section 4.3 reports on average.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，同样的冲突在强制选择解读下表现为几乎必然的拒绝，而当模型用文字或工具调用作答时，则在每个采样响应中都转化为有害行为，这正是第 4.3 节在平均意义上报告的模式。
